# frame calendar system

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:frameCalendarSystem`](gmeow-frameCalendarSystem.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/frameCalendarSystem>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/temporal`](../../slices/temporal.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The calendar system of a temporal frame, when one is used. Optional: some frames (e.g. Julian Date) carry only a scale.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:TemporalFrame`](../classes/gmeow-TemporalFrame.md) -> [`gmeow:CalendarSystem`](../classes/gmeow-CalendarSystem.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:frameCalendarSystem`](gmeow-frameCalendarSystem.md) from [`gmeow:TemporalFrame`](../classes/gmeow-TemporalFrame.md) to [`gmeow:CalendarSystem`](../classes/gmeow-CalendarSystem.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:TemporalFrame`](../classes/gmeow-TemporalFrame.md), [`gmeow:CalendarSystem`](../classes/gmeow-CalendarSystem.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record the calendar a frame reckons dates in when more than a bare scale is needed — civil and historical frames name one of the co-equal calendars (P9).

### Avoid when

- Avoid on scale-only frames (TAI, Julian Date) where no calendar applies, and avoid asserting two calendars (functional — exactly one per frame).

### How to use

- Set at most one seeded [`gmeow:CalendarSystem`](../classes/gmeow-CalendarSystem.md) individual; leave it absent for purely atomic frames, since the property is optional.

### Examples

- ex:myFrame [`gmeow:frameCalendarSystem`](gmeow-frameCalendarSystem.md) [`gmeow:calendarGregorian`](../individuals/gmeow-calendarGregorian.md).
